summary: We present OWE-Bench (OpenWorldEngineer-Bench), a benchmark of 26 long-horizon engineering tasks written by domain experts in software engineering, physical engineering, machine learning, and scientific computing. Tasks range from optimizing kernels and designing an aircraft, to identifying the faults responsible for an earthquake.
takeaways: The best-performing frontier model so far, Claude Fable 5.2, scores 54.6% and averages 211 million tokens per task.
Each task requires significant domain knowledge and engineering work, with models averaging hundreds of millions of tokens per task.

Models also scale differently with test-time compute: GPT-6 Astra achieves higher scores at shorter time limits and at equal token use, while Claude Fable 5.2 uses more tokens at longer limits to achieve the highest overall score.
